mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the biological breakdown of the remaining organic matter in the effluent after primary treatment."
Secondary Treatment is the biological breakdown of the remaining organic matter in the effluent after primary treatment.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to treat and discharge wastewater from toilets, wash basins, bathtubs, washing machines, and other water-consumptive items, which can be sources of high pollutant loads (see Table 12)."

Septic systems are used to treat and discharge wastewater from toilets, wash basins, bathtubs, washing machines, and other water-consumptive items, which can be sources of high pollutant loads (see Table 12).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as any physical or chemical process at the wastewater treatment plant that precedes primary treatment."
Preliminary treatment is defined as any physical or chemical process at the wastewater treatment plant that precedes primary treatment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ability of a body of water to resist or dampen changes in pH."
Buffering capacity is the ability of a body of water to resist or dampen changes in pH.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as that required to achieve pollutant reductions by methods other than those used in conventional treatment (sedimentation, activated sludge, trickling filter, etc.)."

Advanced wastewater treatment is defined as that required to achieve pollutant reductions by methods other than those used in conventional treatment (sedimentation, activated sludge, trickling filter, etc.).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the wastewater reuse concept for urban areas where a centralised sewage collection system is in place, on a large scale."
A dual reticulation system is the wastewater reuse concept for urban areas where a centralised sewage collection system is in place, on a large scale.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same as the subsurface absorption field with the exception of the backfill material."
The trench construction is the same as the subsurface absorption field with the exception of the backfill material.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a specialised area in Environmental Management."
Water and Wastewater Management is a specialised area in Environmental Management.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of the oxygen equivalent of the organic matter in a water sample that is susceptible to oxidation by a strong chemical oxidant, such as dichromate."
COD is a measure of the oxygen equivalent of the organic matter in a water sample that is susceptible to oxidation by a strong chemical oxidant, such as dichromate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those from textiles, lead - acid battery manufacturing, paint, printing, etc."
Examples of such wastewaters are those from textiles, lead - acid battery manufacturing, paint, printing, etc.
fib: ______ is the non-saline (i.e. contains very little percentage of salt chemicals) part of the planet-wide water cycle.
Freshwater
Freshwater is the non-saline (i.e. contains very little percentage of salt chemicals) part of the planet-wide water cycle.
______ is a shallow total retention, pond-like structure in which the effluent is exposed to sunlight and oxygen that enables aerobic bacteria to digest the organic matter.
lagoon
A lagoon is a shallow total retention, pond-like structure in which the effluent is exposed to sunlight and oxygen that enables aerobic bacteria to digest the organic matter.
______ is defined as processes which use biological and, at times, chemical treatment to accomplish substantial removal of dissolved organics and colloidal materials.
Secondary wastewater treatment
Secondary wastewater treatment is defined as processes which use biological and, at times, chemical treatment to accomplish substantial removal of dissolved organics and colloidal materials.
______ is used in many commercial operations, including food services, laundries, laboratories, pharmacies, and car washes.
Water treatment
Water treatment is used in many commercial operations, including food services, laundries, laboratories, pharmacies, and car washes.
______ is the solid/semi-solid substance, concentrated form of mainly organic, and some inorganic impurities (pollutants), generated as a result of treatment of wastewater.
Wastewater sludge
Wastewater sludge is the solid/semi-solid substance, concentrated form of mainly organic, and some inorganic impurities (pollutants), generated as a result of treatment of wastewater.
______ is an essential part of human life, but which must be used in a sustainable way.
Water
Water is an essential part of human life, but which must be used in a sustainable way.
______ means adding treated wastewater directly into the normal drinking water distribution system.
Direct potable reuse
Direct potable reuse means adding treated wastewater directly into the normal drinking water distribution system.
______ is a continuous assessment component of your course.
TMA
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
______ is defined as physical or, at times, chemical treatment for the removal of settleable and floatable materials.
Primary treatment
Primary treatment is defined as physical or, at times, chemical treatment for the removal of settleable and floatable materials.

Constructed wetlands
Constructed wetlands are an effective and relatively low maintenance method of providing on-site wastewater treatment and disposal.
